topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: You ever have that feeling, like the bottom's dropped out of the world and all you're left with is the echo of better times? I showed up, expecting a Different Tomorrows reunion, but no. We sit down, two strangers sipping luke-warm coffee, and it's like the last thirty years never were. "I don't remember," he says, like it's no big deal, like my whole history doesn't mean a thing. Memories, they say, can play tricks, but this isn't a trick—it's a whole damn magician's show, and I didn't get the memo. I'm out, early morning mist or not. Some things, they just don’t survive the rain.
